mLocKeys.keySummary: Valor periodically marks enemies as Vulnerable, whom Quinn can attack to deal bonus damage.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Valor periodically marks a nearby enemy as <keywordMajor>Vulnerable</keywordMajor> for @MarkDuration@ seconds. Quinn's Attacks against <keywordMajor>Vulnerable</keywordMajor> enemies deal <physicalDamage>@BonusDamage@ bonus physical damage</physicalDamage>.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Cooldown is @MarkCooldownPassive@ seconds, reduced to @MarkCooldownConsumed@ if Quinn consumes the mark.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Valor flies out and strikes the first enemy in his path, damaging and blinding all enemies near that point.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
As Quinn: Valor flies out and strikes the first enemy in his path. He then attacks all nearby enemies, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage and Blinding them for @BlindDuration@ seconds.

As Valor: Attack all nearby enemies, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage and Blinding them for @BlindDuration@ seconds.
Quinn has increased movement and attack speed.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Quinn dashes.

As Valor she also dashes.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
As Quinn or Valor: Dash to an enemy, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage, Knocking back and Slowing the target's Movement Speed by @SlowAmount*100@%, diminishing over @SlowDecayTime@ seconds.

As Quinn: Additionally leap off her target and Valor will mark them as Vulnerable.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Quinn dashes farther away if she was initially close to her target.</rules>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Valor flies out and strikes the first enemy in his path, damaging and blinding all enemies near that point.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
As Quinn: Valor flies out and strikes the first enemy in his path. He then attacks all nearby enemies, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage and Blinding them for @BlindDuration@ seconds.

As Valor: Attack all nearby enemies, dealing @TotalDamage@ physical damage and Blinding them for @BlindDuration@ seconds.
Valor is currently fighting. He has increased movement and attack speed and is melee. Skystrike may be cast, dealing a burst of damage and returning Quinn to the battlefield.

mLocKeys.keySummary: Valor replaces Quinn on the battlefield as a mobile melee attacker, gaining movement speed and replacing her abilities. Cast again to perform Skystrike, damaging all nearby enemies.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
First cast: Valor replaces Quinn on the battlefield as a mobile melee attacker for @TransformDuration@ seconds. Valor is Ghosted and gains @OoCMoveSpeed*100@% Move Speed, decreased gradually to @CombatMoveSpeed*100@% when in combat. Valor can then cast Skystrike.

Skystrike: Quinn returns, dealing @TotalDamage@ - @TotalDamageMaximum@ physical damage to all enemies in a large area, based on how much health they are missing.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
If Skystrike has not been cast before this ability ends, it will be cast automatically.
Maximum damage is dealt at @TargetHPforMaxDamage*100@% current Health.

mLocKeys.keyTooltip: Valor has marked this unit. Quinn may attack them to deal bonus damage.

mLocKeys.keySummary:
Passive: Gain stats when triggering vulnerable

Passive as Valor: Gain stats

Active: Reveal an area
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Passive as Quinn: Attacking a Vulnerable target gives Quinn @AttackSpeedBonus*100@% Attack Speed and @MovespeedAmount@ Movement Speed for @BuffDuration@ seconds.

Passive as Valor: Gain @ValorAttackSpeed*100@% Attack Speed.

Active: Valor reveals a large area nearby for @VisionDuration@ seconds.
